Best of luck to Team USA competing in the @Intermountain Freestyle International this week, taking place at @Deer_Valley. The athletes are competing on the '02 Salt Lake Olympic courses. UT-01 is proud to host these amazing events & athletes. #utpol 

https://t.co/91m02vy2OW

Congratulations to Greg Poulsen on his appointment to the Medicare Payment Advisory Commission! Greg is a valuable member of my Debt and Deficit Task Force, and I know he will bring his strong expertise and Utah’s values to the table. #utpol

https://t.co/IPIQxnmV5s

I met with our military community at @HAFB to learn about their current challenges. Many shared about inadequate military housing & healthcare, & I shared how my team & I advocated for provisions in the NDAA to help military families access better housing & healthcare options. https://t.co/MUhOEhJMWF

Conscience protections prevent discrimination and ensure Americans in the healthcare sector are not forced to violate their beliefs. Pharmacists, along with other medical and healthcare workers, should never be coerced into participating in abortions. (2/3)

I joined students at @UUtah’s  @hinckleyinst for a conversation about my work on healthcare, education, national security, and our national debt and deficit crises. It was a great event, and I always appreciate the opportunity to answer questions from students. #utpol https://t.co/JO26xnTGTI

Our seniors deserve access to the best quality of care available, which is why I'm proud to introduce the Ensuring Patient Access to Critical Breakthrough Products Act. #utpol (1/3)

https://t.co/QWWxoFVyL4

This bill will cut regulatory red tape & allow Medicare enrollees the ability to use breakthrough medical devices. Utah’s medical device industry is leading the way in bringing revolutionary care to our nation’s seniors. #utpol  (2/3)

Please join me for a tele-town hall on Thursday at 11am! We'll discuss the work my team & I are doing on the @WaysandMeansGOP & @housebudgetGOP committees to address issues that impact each & every Utahn, from Social Security & Medicare to taxes & energy costs. Call in! #utpol https://t.co/S2wvi9Cmlj

I introduced the Advancing Health Saving Act to help patients access the benefits of their health savings accounts as soon as they are covered under an HSA-eligible high deductible health plan, lower their cost of care, & empower patients to take charge of their health care.

This bill is a commonsense reform measure that will give patients peace of mind in knowing they have access to the savings afforded by HSAs for certain medical expenses incurred before they could establish their HSA.

I spoke in a @waysandmeansgop Work & Welfare Subcommittee hearing this week about the need for smarter welfare policies that rely on data to responsibly distribute federal resources—including SNAP and Medicaid—without exasperating our federal spending crisis. Watch here. #utpol https://t.co/xhgddhkzvR

Recently, the Biden Administration proposed a new rule limiting the scope of the minerals that are eligible for coverage and expedited permitting under Title 41 of the Fixing America’s Surface Transportation Act (FAST-41). Limiting the scope to critical minerals will harm America’s ability to quickly and effectively produce minerals like copper, iron, and host minerals from which we derive critical minerals. #utpol

🧵Today, the fastest-growing part of the federal budget isn’t infrastructure, education, healthcare, or even defense. It is the interest payments on the 
national debt itself.

Chronic illnesses affect more than 40% of Americans, costing Medicare and Medicaid $384 billion every year. I spoke in @WaysandMeansGOP to address this health crisis and the comprehensive actions Congress can take to alleviate the financial burden on our government while enhancing the lives of those who suffer from chronic illnesses.

Health care costs are one of the biggest issues I hear about from UT patients, providers, & employers, & addressing this pressing issue is a top priority for me in DC. That is why I reintroduced the bipartisan HOPE Act to create a new tax-advantaged savings account that will help families plan & save for medical expenses. This bill is a step in the right direction in making health care more affordable for Utahns & Americans across the country.

Learn more here ⬇️ 
https://t.co/WDT4DXa9nz
I look forward to leading the @HouseBudgetGOP Health Care Task Force! Together we will find ways we can improve health care outcomes while reducing costs for both the patient and the taxpayer.

If we are to get our fiscal house in order, we have to tackle health care spending, which has ballooned to nearly 30% of our over $6T budget. This task force will be instrumental in addressing our health care cost inefficiencies to ensure we can take care of patients’ needs & lower this massive budgetary line item.
Learn more here: https://t.co/RlR2tEdisF

Healthy diets lower costs to our health care system and are key to personal wellbeing. In its current form, SNAP is in many cases enabling food deserts and costly chronic conditions like diabetes in America’s poorest communities. As the Chair of the Health Care Task Force, I look forward to collaborating with the @HouseBudgetGOP and my fellow Budget Committee members to assess the budgetary impacts of establishing health criteria to SNAP so we can ensure recipients have access to healthy options and Congress has information on SNAP’s impact on federal health care spending. @USCBO

I recently penned an op-ed with my friend @RepJimmyPanetta on our legislation to establish HOPE Accounts, an innovative savings tool to help individuals and families save for medical costs.

Give it a read here! ⬇️
https://t.co/mOXlCUoVFr

I appreciated hearing from Commissioner Bisignano in the Social Security and Work & Welfare Subcommittee Hearing on cyberattacks and the modernization of our Social Security records. Half of all medical records received by state disability determination services are received via mail or fax. We’re working to make this process more efficient while still protecting Americans’ data.

Seniors wait on average 5-6 years from when the FDA authorizes a breakthrough technology until Medicare actually covers it. I’m leading legislation that ensures our most innovative devices have a clear roadmap to Medicare coverage so our seniors can reap the benefits sooner. https://t.co/bqRDqd6zRF

It was great to be a part of the bipartisan roundtable with CMS Administrator Dr. Oz! We discussed health care innovation, helping Americans adopt healthier lifestyles, protecting taxpayers against waste, and my legislation to support access to healthcare and breakthrough devices. I appreciate @DrOzCMS leadership and expertise on these matters.

I convened my Debt and Deficit Task Force in Ogden to discuss the budget reconciliation bill, tariffs, healthcare, and other legislation impacting our national debt. Maintaining regular involvement with this group of constituents, stakeholders, and Utah businesses is essential for receiving candid feedback on how organizations are navigating ongoing policy changes. I was also glad to invite Will Burger from @AFPhq, who highlighted some wins from the OBBB and updated the task force on AFP’s upcoming projects.
